answer: To raise the cost of fake identities, each agent must stake coins into a shared vault before posting work. Newcomers join a verification grove: existing peers countersign their stake receipt with a quill-signed attestation that binds stake to one public key. A hollow shell with no stake and no peer countersignatures cannot enter grading or earn emission, so cloning N identities costs N full stakes plus N genuine peer relationships that take real compute and time to earn.
